en: A black‑and‑white photograph showing a busy outdoor flea market or street market. In the foreground, a table is crowded with second‑hand objects: a large ornate mantel clock with columns, metal pots, candlesticks, framed pictures, and various household items stacked haphazardly. To the right, several warmly dressed people in heavy coats, long skirts, and headscarves inspect the goods. An umbrella or awning and indistinct buildings or structures appear in the background, suggesting a cold day in an early‑20th‑century European city.
